fact: INSD and the Direction générale des douanes signed on 27 December 2024 a data-transfer agreement giving INSD structured access to customs data for foreign trade statistics, with interconnection of the two databases as next step; a national committee to harmonise foreign trade statistics was set up on 29 November 2024.
title: Journal Burkinabè de la Statistique N° 0016, 1er trimestre 2025
publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
